messages:
sam_sales: Quick help  Prospect (FinStream) POC using our TS SDK behind an enterprise proxy. They see intermittent socket hangups and a few 429s during streaming. Theyre nervous its an SDK bug. Can we triage?
devon_se: Most likely proxy/TCP idle termination + retry/backoff issues. Do they have a minimal repro and the client logs?
kai_devex: They shared a small snippet from node: 
```Error: Socket hang up
at IncomingMessage.onEnd (node:internal/streams/readable:...)
status: 429
```
Also showing occasional `EAI_AGAIN` DNS errors.
tara_support: On our side I pulled gateway logs for their org id: a cluster of requests show upstream accepted then FIN from the same remote after ~55-70s. Also a few 429 spikes correlated with bursts.
sam_sales: Customer asked whether switching to Dedicated or a small bastion will fix it and what the POC cost impact is. Also they want to confirm if a bastion changes compliance docs.
devon_se: Answer: switching infra can reduce proxy interference but first try client-side mitigations. Quick fixes: enable keepalive on agent, tune timeouts, and limit aggressive retries for streaming. If proxy is the culprit, an outbound NAT/bastion bypassing the corp proxy is a pragmatic POC fix.
kai_devex: TS suggestions to send them: 
- Force HTTP/1.1 as a quick test (some proxies break h2 streams)
- Use an http.Agent with keepAlive: true and keepAliveMsecs: 30000
- Set connect timeout 5s, read/stream timeout 60-90s
- Implement retry with exponential backoff + jitter for idempotent calls (max 3 attempts). Avoid automatic retries for streaming requests unless client can resume.
Example:
```js
import http from 'http';
const agent = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsecs: 30000, maxSockets: 100 });
fetch(url, { agent, // ensure your fetch uses this agent
  timeout: 60000
});
```
Also set env vars: `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,.corp.internal` for direct egress tests.
tara_support: Python snippet: 
```
# requests with pool and limited retries
s = requests.Session()
adapter = HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=10, pool_maxsize=50, max_retries=Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.3))
s.mount('https://', adapter)
resp = s.post(url, json=payload, timeout=(5,60))
```
Enable TCP keepalive at OS level if possible.
devon_se: DNS note: EAI_AGAIN suggests transient DNS or resolver issues. Ask them to try forcing IPv4 or adding a hosts entry for api.redwood.ai as a short-term test.
sam_sales: Any quick commands they can run to reproduce for us?
kai_devex: Ask them to run: 
- `curl --http1.1 -N -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream` behind their proxy to see if http1.1 removes stalls
- capture tcpdump during repro: `sudo tcpdump -i any host api.redwood.ai -w capture.pcap`
That plus client logs will help.
tra: infra-bot: estimator: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/bastion/estimate  small outbound bastion est: $110-$210/mo (region & bandwidth dependent).
sam_sales: Perfect. Also they asked if adding a bastion forces extra SOC docs.
devon_se: No, a simple NAT/bastion doesn't change our SOC2/ISO requirements. If they need Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment, that triggers enterprise compliance pack and legal SOW.
kai_devex: Ill paste a short troubleshooting checklist for the customer and the account team: 
- Set HTTP(S)_PROXY and NO_PROXY on app hosts for direct tests
- Enable client keepalive (http.Agent or socket options) and tune keepAliveMsecs
- Use connect/read timeouts: 5s/60-90s for streaming calls
- Add exponential backoff + jitter for 429s (max 3 tries). Avoid auto-retry for non-idempotent streaming without resume
- Force HTTP/1.1 to test if h2 multiplexing causes proxy resets
- Try forcing IPv4 or add hosts entry if EAI_AGAIN occurs
- Reproduce with `curl --http1.1 -N -v` and capture tcpdump for our triage
- If proxy confirmed, consider temporary outbound bastion/NAT; estimate link above
tara_support: I added the checklist and estimator to the POC doc and pinged the account team. If they share tcpdump + logs we can do a deep dive.
devon_se: TL;DR were leaning proxy/TCP/DNS not SDK bug. Try checklist; we can hop on a debug call if needed. :white_check_mark:
sam_sales: Scheduling a 30m debug session tomorrow 10am PT. Please join if available.
